attchmntText: Action Construction Equipment Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Action Construction Equipment Limited submitted newspaper advertisements to the BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026. The advertisements were published in the Financial Express and Jansatta. They announce the Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This filing complies with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The submission is for information and record purposes.

attchmntText: Action Construction Equipment Limited has informed the Earning Presentation
voiceSummary: Action Construction Equipment Limited filed an earnings presentation for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2027 with the BSE and NSE on November 12, 2026. The company reported consolidated total income of INR 9,322 Mn for Q2 FY27, representing a 20.5% year-on-year increase. EBITDA stood at INR 1,800 Mn, up 30.2% year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 19.31%. Profit after tax was INR 1,643 Mn, an 82.4% year-on-year rise, yielding a PAT margin of 17.62%. Diluted EPS was INR 13.80 per share. For the half-year period, total income reached INR 17,725 Mn, up 20.0% year-on-year. EBITDA was INR 3,525 Mn, up 24.9% year-on-year, with a margin of 19.89%. Profit after tax was INR 2,837 Mn, up 51.1% year-on-year, with a margin of 16.01%. Diluted EPS for the half-year was INR 23.84 per share. The company also announced the commencement of a 50:50 joint venture with KATO WORKS CO., LTD. for crawler and truck cranes.

attchmntText: Action Construction Equipment Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Action Construction Equipment Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 12, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 88,352 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 16,297 lakhs. Basic earnings per share stood at Rs. 13.70. Consolidated revenue from operations for the same quarter was Rs. 88,609 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 16,425 lakhs. Consolidated basic earnings per share was Rs. 13.80. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 1,66,520 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 28,156 lakhs. Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs. 1,67,177 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 28,374 lakhs. The limited review reports of the auditors are enclosed with the announcement.
